name: Montgomery County 4-H clubs (including Teens for a Better Tomorrow)
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club to build leadership, citizenship and life skills. Teens can join the Teens for a Better Tomorrow club. It focuses on leadership, career readiness and community service. Many members serve as camp counselors-in-training.
who_can_apply: Community and project clubs are for ages 9 through 18. The home school Senior club is ages 14 to 19. Clubs have size limits and fill first come, first served, and they depend on volunteer leaders.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the clubs page. Ask the Extension office.
duration: Clubs meet 9 to 12 months a year. Home school clubs meet Oct to early May.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Clubs fill first come, first served.
how_to_apply: Email one of the Extension 4-H staff on the page. They are Kendra Young kkyoung@vt.edu, Lesa Miller lvmiller@vt.edu and Margarita Palomino mrpalomi@vt.edu. Or call the Montgomery County Extension office at 540-382-5790. Staff pass your request to the club leaders.
notes: The clubs page does not give an age rule or meeting time for the Teens for a Better Tomorrow club, so ask staff. This is a youth club, not a paid job.
